dependencies.name: Vercel Cloud Platform
dependencies.purpose: Static Edge Web Hosting, Zero-Build Frontend Serving, CDN Edge Routing
dependencies.failureImpact: CRITICAL: Frontend SPA interface becomes inaccessible.
dependencies.fallbackStrategy: Direct backup static file server (Caddy / Nginx) or local PWA offline shell cache.

dependencies.name: Render Cloud Services
dependencies.purpose: Node.js Express Production Backend Web Service & 10GB Persistent Document Disk
dependencies.failureImpact: CRITICAL: Core API and document uploads become unavailable.
dependencies.fallbackStrategy: Point-in-time container restart or failover to secondary container instance.

dependencies.name: MongoDB Atlas
dependencies.purpose: 3-Node Managed Replica Set (AWS Mumbai ap-south-1), Multi-Tenant Data Store
dependencies.failureImpact: CRITICAL: Complete transactional data store unavailable.
dependencies.fallbackStrategy: Automated replica-set failover; read-only mode if primary lost; PITR snapshot restore.

dependencies.name: GitHub & GitHub Actions
dependencies.purpose: Source Control, Protected Production Rulesets, CI/CD Pipeline & Invariant Gate Verification
dependencies.failureImpact: HIGH: Release pipeline blocked; production runtime remains operational.
dependencies.fallbackStrategy: Local emergency tag and manual deploy deployment via CLI if authorized.

dependencies.name: Google Workspace / Gmail API
dependencies.purpose: Operational Mailbox Dispatch, Security Alert Delivery, Daily Report Emailing
dependencies.failureImpact: MEDIUM: Outbound email delayed; transactions and POS continue uninterrupted.
dependencies.fallbackStrategy: In-app notifications via Notification model and NotificationOutbox queue retry.

dependencies.name: External Malware Scanner (Pending Provider)
dependencies.purpose: Off-Site Antivirus Binary Scanning for Uploaded Business Attachments
dependencies.failureImpact: LOW (Controlled): Heuristic scanner remains active; external scan remains in quarantine until completed.
dependencies.fallbackStrategy: Local signature & header heuristic engine blocks EICAR, MZ, PE, ELF, and malicious PDF triggers.
